name: Up and Over (Combat)
body:
You strike with such force that your enemy is thrust into the air, then slammed into the ground behind you.

Prerequisite(s): Power Attack, base attack bonus +6

Benefit: As part of a successful Power Attack, you can make a Reposition Combat Maneuver that does not provoke an attack of opportunity. If successful the creature is moved to the square on the other side of you and knocked prone.

Normal: A Reposition combat maneuver provokes an attack of opportunity.
